transcript: Weighing a star thousands of light years away is hard, so every measurement comes with an uncertainty range. Two heavy pulsars matter here. One weighs in at 1.97 sons, give or take 0.04, just under 2. The other, 2.08, give or take 0.07. At the 68.3% level the paper quotes, that one clears two sons. At the stricter 95.4% level, the closing record says it does not.
